title: Leaning Mod
description: A simple lean animation to spy on your freinds!
body:
**Description:**

a simple mod that allows you to lean half a block left or right. I got inspired to make this mod from the video game "Shadows of Doubt". It gets a little cursed when you look around leaning. lol. It allows you to see, but not interact around corners. For example, if you lean around a corner, you wont be able to shoot the player.

**Controls:**

Left Lean: Left Arrow Key

Right Lean: Right Arrow Key

Where to find it in keybinds: Movement

I hope you like my first mod!
